units.summary: Adds a test helper that returns the source paths of mocked cp calls with backslashes normalized to forward slashes. It lets assertions on copied guide files work on Windows and has no production effect.
units.headline: Test helper normalizes mocked cp source paths
units.reason: New test-only helper that reads mock calls; it cannot affect production behavior.

units.summary: Updates the upgrade prompt tests for the new split guides (shared, same-major, different-major, future-defaults). Snapshots and path expectations changed to match the new behavior, the old writeFile codemod-command assertion on the canary test was removed, and new tests cover guide selection and the Future Defaults guide copy.
units.headline: Tests updated for split per-policy agentic upgrade guides
units.reason: Existing expectations and snapshots were changed to match new behavior and an assertion was removed, which can hide regressions.
risk_signals: expectations changed to match new behavior
focus: The canary handoff test no longer asserts the codemod command 'upgrade 17.2.0-canary.9 --yes --skip-adoption'. Confirm the codemod command is still covered for cross-major upgrades.
The updated inline snapshots match the intended prompt wording, including the Future Defaults guide line and the 'No Future Defaults are pending adoption' fallback.
The negative checks on future-defaults.md and /02-pages/ copies use normalized paths and are not vacuous.
